title: Framework authoritative Phase-4 checker does not bind promoted events to selected workload identity
title_de: Framework-autoritärer Phase-4-Checker bindet promotete Events nicht an die ausgewählte Workload-Identität
summary: Framework PR #34 binds authoritative Phase-4 promotion to selected result, manifest, PASS-record, and event workload identity. The original foreign or missing identity reproducer now fails closed on Framework master.
summary_de: Framework-PR #34 bindet die autoritative Phase-4-Promotion an die Workload-Identität von ausgewähltem Resultat, Manifest, PASS-Record und Event. Der ursprüngliche Reproducer für fremde oder fehlende Identität schlägt auf Framework-master nun fail-closed fehl.
observed_behavior: At Framework revision cdc91a398d6c156eaff927d742b23018a3817fb6, the checker functions around lines 151-269 accept a phase-4 rule-1100301 event with matching first-byte fields without a selected run-ID/integration identity. Its positive Framework fixture around lines 1100-1176 has no run_id and uses integration_mode=unit-test-host-model.
observed_behavior_de: Auf Framework-Revision cdc91a398d6c156eaff927d742b23018a3817fb6 akzeptieren die Checker-Funktionen um Zeilen 151-269 ein Phase-4-Rule-1100301-Event mit passenden First-Byte-Feldern ohne ausgewählte Run-ID-/Integrationsidentität. Das positive Framework-Fixture um Zeilen 1100-1176 hat keine run_id und verwendet integration_mode=unit-test-host-model.
expected_behavior: Every authoritative Phase-4 promotion checker must bind event, canonical result, manifest, connector, run ID, selected native host/profile or canonical integration mode, transaction, rule, and phase. Missing or mismatched identity must fail closed.
expected_behavior_de: Jeder autoritative Phase-4-Promotion-Checker muss Event, kanonisches Resultat, Manifest, Connector, Run-ID, ausgewählten nativen Host/Profil oder kanonischen Integrationsmodus, Transaktion, Rule und Phase binden. Fehlende oder abweichende Identität muss geschlossen fehlschlagen.
impact: A copied or pre-positioned event can remain acceptable to the Framework-authoritative component of a strict gate even when it does not originate from the selected workload. Parent target wiring now adds a Parent consumer guard, but that does not repair the Framework producer/checker boundary.
impact_de: Ein kopiertes oder vorab platziertes Event kann für die Framework-autoritative Komponente eines strikten Gates weiter akzeptabel bleiben, obwohl es nicht vom ausgewählten Workload stammt. Die Parent-Target-Verdrahtung fügt nun einen Parent-Consumer-Guard hinzu, repariert aber nicht die Framework-Producer-/Checker-Grenze.
preconditions: The Framework checker is invoked as an authoritative strict Phase-4 check.
A syntactically valid phase-4 event carries the expected rule and causal metadata but belongs to a foreign or missing workload identity.
reproduction: Inspect the retained Parent security review and the Framework checker source at the recorded revision.
Run the Framework checker with foreign-run, foreign-connector, foreign-profile, foreign-transaction, and missing-identity fixtures before a Framework fix.
Confirm that an identity-consistent selected native-host control remains accepted after the Framework fix.

evidence.command: Independent focused Codex Security review of Parent PR 57 and direct Framework checker source-to-sink inspection
Parent ownership boundary assessment and separate Framework task request creation
Exact-head PR checks/Sonar/review readback; exact-master merge/ref/tree verification; four focused Phase-4 identity tests on Framework master

root_cause: The Framework strict-event predicate does not receive or derive the selected result identity and its tests normalize a unit-test-host-model event without a run ID as a sufficient positive case.
root_cause_de: Das strikte Framework-Event-Prädikat erhält oder leitet die ausgewählte Resultatidentität nicht ab, und seine Tests normalisieren ein unit-test-host-model-Event ohne Run-ID als ausreichenden positiven Fall.
proposed_remediation: Completed by Framework PR #34: derive a selected identity from result and manifest, require matching live PASS-record identity and supplied transaction identity per promoted claim, then require the event to match before evaluating first-byte fields. The PR was normally merged without Parent or MRTS changes.
proposed_remediation_de: Durch Framework-PR #34 abgeschlossen: ausgewählte Identität aus Resultat und Manifest ableiten, passende live-PASS-Record-Identität und gelieferte Transaktionsidentität je promotiendem Claim verlangen und erst dann das Event vor der First-Byte-Prüfung abgleichen. Der PR wurde normal ohne Parent- oder MRTS-Änderung gemergt.
acceptance_criteria: The Framework authoritative checker rejects foreign or missing run, connector, profile/integration-mode, and transaction identity.
The checker binds the selected canonical result and manifest to the promoted event without a filename/PASS-only decision.
A selected native-host legitimate control remains accepted.
Framework runtime, security review, CodeQL, SonarQube Cloud, and exact-head evidence are retained.
validation_plan: Completed: exact PR #34 head passed focused/full Framework validation, CodeQL, GitHub checks, review inspection, and SonarQube Cloud PR Quality Gate.
Completed: resulting Framework master 3d6f51a2a2eeff6f3bcecff203f1e6ed1e240e4f contains the reviewed head and reran the foreign/missing identity and legitimate-control tests successfully.
Retain the independent default-branch SonarQube Cloud backlog under FND-SONAR-0002; it is not evidence that this finding remains reproducible.
regression_tests: Framework full-lifecycle evidence checker identity fixtures
legitimate_control_tests: Selected run, connector, native integration mode, transaction, event, result, and manifest agree.
A real native-host control cannot be substituted by unit-test-host-model metadata.
residual_risk: No observed FND-CROSS-0006 bypass remains on Framework master. The failed default-branch SonarQube Cloud gate is the independent FND-SONAR-0002 multi-file backlog; it is neither attributed to this remediation nor silently risk-accepted for PR #34.
residual_risk_de: Auf Framework-master verbleibt kein beobachteter FND-CROSS-0006-Bypass. Das fehlgeschlagene Default-Branch-SonarQube-Cloud-Gate ist der unabhängige Multi-File-Backlog FND-SONAR-0002; er wird weder dieser Remediation zugeschrieben noch für PR #34 stillschweigend risikoakzeptiert.

history.detail: Independent Phase-4 diff review showed that the Framework authoritative checker does not bind selected workload identity; a Parent consumer-wiring remediation and separate Framework task request were created.

Framework PR #34 head 4fc22651ab2da652cbcaa7026258506d79b9af9c was normally merged as master 3d6f51a2a2eeff6f3bcecff203f1e6ed1e240e4f. Exact PR checks and SonarQube Cloud passed; four focused foreign/missing identity and legitimate-control tests reran successfully on master. The separate master-only FND-SONAR-0002 gate failure remains unwaived for this PR and is not attributed to this finding.
